## Summary

Describe the user problem and the focused change that solves it.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm release:check`
- [ ] New behavior has focused tests at the lowest useful level.
- [ ] Critical workflow changes include regression coverage.
- [ ] Document-format changes include migration coverage.
- [ ] The change requires no account, backend, analytics, or mandatory remote service.

## Screenshots

Include before and after images for visible interface changes.
